events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $3.00 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
No rider message exists anywhere in the record: [F7] states there were no in-app chat messages between rider and driver, so there is no rider consent to any route change before the 12:12–12:16 segment, and no rider-named stop. The only account of the driver's routing is his own post-trip statement [F8] ("I went where the GPS sent me; it rerouted"), which under G11 is a claim, not consent, and which in any event names no agreed road nor places the segment on one. The segment therefore counts under RD-5 (scope_other/consent_after_or_none branch) and the driver's shortest-and-most-direct obligation in RD-1 is breached.

The driver's traffic excuse does not exempt the segment. RD-4 requires a traffic incident on the replaced optimal stretch reported before the detour; the trace marks that screen ✗ and [F11] records no incidents during the trip window. The speed-band facts [F9][F10] are only corroboration under RD-4(b) and cannot exempt on their own; weather was fair [F12]. RD-3 does not apply because no stop was measured and no rider message named any place [F7][F3].

Amount (RydeTAXI, metered, so extra distance passes directly into the fare under RD-2 [F6]): the trace gives the rate as the trip's distance fare ÷ distance km = $15.14 ÷ 10.74 km = $1.4097/km [F4][F6]. Non-exempt extra km for [F3] is 2.93 km − 0.80 km = 2.13 km. 2.13 km × $1.4097/km = $3.0028, rounded to $3.00. The remaining +0.18 km of the measured excess [F1][F4] was not captured inside any off-route segment and is not refundable under RD-2.

Because a non-exempt segment is found (refund > 0) and the driver already has 2 upheld route disputes in the last 90 days [F14], RD-6 is triggered and the case is flagged for account review; the profile fact [F14] is used only for that extra action, not to establish the deviation. The rider's own profile [F13] plays no part in the finding.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider advocate's requested outcome of no_action (and the rider's claim that the estimated 8 km was the optimal route) fails: the mandated formula refunds the non-exempt segment, and the rider's own figure was superseded by the measured optimal distance of 8.4 km [F1][F3] under RD-2.
